okay, let me update

One remaining issue, please.

The new rectangle is left drawn on the map when we finish creating the shapes.  I think we need to (optionally) remember it in state, and delete it when we finish.

Demo:  https://i.gyazo.com/ff89650eea2207523dc874c55fda21a6.mp4

sure @IanMayo, I will update after dinner 👍🏻

Sorry @lebaphi -  I think this still isn't quite right.  As soon as we have planned the polygon (either by selecting a standard area, or drawing a polygon) - then the standard-areas menu should disappear. I know we don't want it there when the `route back` line is being drawn.  The logic to control this is in the `standardPolygons` state.  When this is zero or undefined, the we should not show the standard area menu.  Looking at it another way, we should only show the standard area menu when `standardPolygons` is contains items.

issues.title: When adding a `Standard Area` to a planning order - show the area
issues.body:
For polygons in orders, players can either add them by drawing them, or add them from the drop-down list.

If they draw them, they are able to see the shape on the map.  But, if they select it from the list it isn't shown.

It would be good if _Somehow_ we could add the new shape to the drawing layer - so it gets drawn and the player can review what they are doing.  It also helps the player plan their `route back`.

We _probably_ have to push the `Layer` for the new shape into the GeoMan layer in `OrderDrawing`.   Hmm, if we do that, _maybe_ we no longer need to insert the shape ourselves - maybe the `GeoMan`  handler will jump onto it.
